summary: No experiment commits were recorded within the timing window for milestone 2026.05.247 — this is a planning-only milestone (twenty-second consecutive empty-timing-window retro). The 13-task roadmap (exp2569–exp2581) was validated with gate audit passing and pre-staged for activation; no compute-bound work executed.
bottlenecks_identified: Structural planning-execution gap: 22 consecutive milestones have completed planning without any experiment execution within the timing window. The conductor loop reaches the retro trigger before activating any experiment tasks.
GPU resources fully idle (both RTX 3090s at 0% utilization, 5 MB allocated each) despite a validated roadmap with compute-bound tasks (exp2572, exp2573, exp2574, exp2575, exp2576) ready to run.
Retro trigger fires before experiment activation — the retro is capturing the planning phase rather than the execution phase, making timing-window data structurally empty every milestone.
improvements_suggested: Activate at least one experiment task (exp2569 HF citation compliance or exp2572 tier0s real-corpus retraining) in the same session immediately after planning, before the retro trigger fires.
Deploy a persistent conductor daemon that runs between operator sessions to close the planning-execution gap without requiring operator presence to initiate each experiment.
Gate the retro trigger on minimum_experiments_completed >= 1 to prevent empty-timing-window retros from consuming turn budget and obscuring the structural pipeline stall.

Consider reducing milestone scope to 8 tasks (from 13) so the conductor can complete the full cycle within a single operator session, rather than deferring execution to a follow-on session that may not occur before the next retro fires.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Activate exp2569 (HF citation compliance) or exp2572 (tier0s real-corpus AUROC retraining) immediately in the same session as this retro, converting this milestone from planning-only to execution-in-progress before session end.
Deploy a persistent conductor daemon (openspec/change-proposals/conductor-process-isolation.md) to eliminate the structural gap between planning and execution across operator session boundaries.

Modify the retro trigger in scripts/research_conductor.py to require minimum_experiments_completed >= 1 before firing an operational retro, preventing the 22-consecutive-empty-window pattern from recurring.
meta_reflection: The twenty-second consecutive empty-timing-window retro confirms this is a structural issue with the conductor's retro trigger firing too early in the milestone lifecycle, not a one-off gap. The validated roadmap and idle GPUs indicate readiness to execute; the blocking factor is the session boundary between planning and activation. The highest-leverage operational change is same-session activation — zero infrastructure investment required, immediate impact.
